title: Add region mucosa: 29,069 cells
details: Your words: “Draw the mucosa of this section as a region named mucosa, from the H&E and the epithelial and lamina propria cells.”
Outlined by the agent from the mucosa compartment (where its lineages form tissue); the figure shows the outline on the H&E.
Adds 1 polygon(s) as region mucosa; reshape it afterwards with the Regions tools (Brush adds, Alt+Brush erases), and Undo takes it back.
